verdict.rationale: Docs claim AvaTax applies consistent tax logic across ecommerce, marketplace, POS, and ERP systems (avalara-docs-20, avalara-docs-30) and provides SDKs/APIs for building integrations (avalara-docs-3, avalara-docs-24), implying broad compatibility, but the evidence pack contains no list of specific maintained connectors/plugins for named billing systems, payment processors, or commerce platforms (e.g., Shopify, Stripe, NetSuite) that a developer could just plug in without building integration code. Missing for 10: named pre-built connector/plugin documentation for specific platforms, evidence of maintenance/update cadence for such integrations, and independent confirmation that these integrations work out-of-the-box.
